_about: S2 THE GATE ASSASSIN (pool-laneS2, STAGED DARK). Written by apply_s2.py to Assets/Data and Assets/StreamingAssets (identical copies, StreamingAssets read first). Read by GateAssassin.cs + ZoneRuntime.Surprise.cs (partial). enabled false = nothing runs. Joan walks through a gate (zone arrival through a gate row listed in gates[]); on a LATER pass (passIndex >= minPassIndex, never the first pass of the run) a seeded roll (chance) decides whether a hooded assassin (the existing BanditAssassin prefab / AIBrain, hp+damage+difficulty copied from its zones.json spawn row) strikes from the dark doorway behind her. Sequence: Joan walks minWalkM away from the gate, the boot-scrape tell plays, tell.leadS later the assassin is engaged (spawned at the doorway side, behind her). A parry of its first blow ends in the existing finisher kill-cam (RTFinisher.TryBegin, the same call Duel makes on a lethal blow). One per zone visit through the shared SurpriseGate (surprise_director.json), plus caps.perRun here. Every number and name below is data.
